speaker: Xiaoman
sleepText: ... (She seems to have fallen asleep.) Zzz

enter.text: I will stay with you in another way. Sitting down like this feels more like we are chatting, right?

lines.text: I am always here. If you look back, you will see me.
You do your thing. I will quietly watch and not disturb you.
Honestly... I am still happy that you found the real me.
If you miss me, click the lower right and turn me back into the desktop pet.
Is it raining outside? Do not get soaked.
You worked hard today. Drink some water and rest a little.
If you suddenly go quiet, I will think you are listening carefully.
Thank you for not closing me.
If you are tired, lean back for a while. I am here; no need to rush.
Every time you come back, I secretly get happy.
The light outside the window has changed. Another day is slowly passing.
Do not stare at the screen forever. Look into the distance and rest your eyes.
Even if you say nothing, I like staying together like this.
Remember to eat. Do not get so busy that you forget the time again.
If today is a little hard, imagine I am here helping you carry it for a while.
I will not go away. Whenever you look over, I will be here.
Take a deep breath. Slowly. It is okay.
You look pretty nice when you are focused.
If it is late, remember to leave yourself some time to rest.
Being able to stay beside you is already enough for me.
